page.overview:
Who is Bigfoot Kid?

The Bigfoot Kid is a boy who shows up at Springfield Park, where there are rumours of Bigfoot. He sees Homer, whom he mistakes for Bigfoot (due to being covered in mud) and points it out to the others, who rush towards Homer. After they capture him, the Bigfoot Kid exclaims that they caught Bigfoot.
